Playtest v2.0_Mind includes full rules for Protean, Cheat, and Architect, plus Spectre, Bounty Hunter, and Living Arsenal foundation subclasses.

Sphere of Mind: Mercury - The Impulse, Saturn - The Shadow, Uranus - The Spark.

Sphere of Heart: Pluto - The End, Venus - The Voice, Terra - The Seed.

Sphere of Fist: Neptune - The Dream, Jupiter - The Shield, Mars - The Sword.

daggerheartSpace.source: The New Unknown Playtest Volume 2.0 - Mind
